name: Ballgel
text: Ballgel is a lady of the fairy people in the old tales of Ireland. Her name carries the sense of bright-limbed, a figure of shining movement. She dwells on the royal plain of the east known as Brega. The same name belongs to several persons who stand in older Irish genealogies.

attributes.attribute: lady of the sidhe in Brega
name borne by several genealogical figures
